splash.sub: A gentle bilingual sanctuary for young learners and parents

hero.title: Little buds blooming at home
hero.desc: Children aged 2.5 to 6 learn best at home with parents, hands-on, with very little screen time. Gentle 20-minute daily adventures followed by screen-free joyful activities.
hero.kaliGreeting: Assalam-o-Alaikum friends! I am Kali. Let's learn and play together in our garden!
hero.dragTip: Tip: You can gently drag Kali around!

ageCards.heading: Choose Your Learning Journey
ageCards.subheading: Pick the best age group for your child
ageCards.littleDesc: Playful, hands-on discovery with parents. Daily Duas, gentle manners, fine-motor games, action poems, finger tracing, swipeable picture stories & weekly screen-free projects.
ageCards.juniorDesc: Curious minds explore mental maths challenges, English & Urdu grammar, safe home science experiments with Professor Ullu, and timed logic quizzes.

timer.title: Today's Plan / 20-Minute Timer
timer.desc: Gentle screen time limit. When time is up, screen locks for hands-on home play!
timer.overSubtitle: Time for a hands-on home activity with family!
timer.dadiPrompt: Dadi Kachwa says: Time to put the screen away and play with your hands!

screenFree.title: Color Mixing with Water & Ice Cups
screenFree.desc: Take 3 transparent cups, water, and food colors. Watch yellow and blue create green magic together!
screenFree.safetyDesc: Adult supervision required when handling liquids and ice cubes.

islamic.quote: Noori lights our garden with gentle Duas and Bismillah before everything we do!
islamic.wuduTitle: 4 Steps of Wudu for Little Hands

manners.quote: Good manners make our words sweet like honey and hearts full of joy!
manners.gameDesc: Look at the scenario and tap Right or Wrong!
manners.weeklyChallenge: Weekly Manners Challenge: Give 3 warm Salams with a big smile today!

fineMotor.quote: Little fingers do big work! Tearing paper, rolling dough, and sorting colors.
fineMotor.sortGameTitle: Sort Green Items into the Garden Basket!
fineMotor.sortGameDesc: Tap all the green items to drop them into the garden basket.

poems.quote: Sing, rhyme, and move your little wings with happy Urdu and English poems!

speaking.quote: Listen to the sweet sound, repeat with Mitthu, and say your first words!

tracing.quote: Follow the gentle lines with your tiny finger. Straight lines, curves, letters and stars!

stories.quote: Cozy illustrated picture books with gentle lessons, questions and parent activities.

weekly.title: Weekly Screen-Free Home Project
weekly.themeTitle: This Week's Theme: Water, Allah's Blessing
weekly.projectDesc: Fold paper flower petals toward the center. Place it on a bowl of water and watch it bloom on its own!
weekly.uploadSuccess: Photo uploaded successfully! Teacher feedback: 'Mashallah, creative little scientist!'
